issues.title: [Feature] Há caminho SDK para acrescentar filtros de seleção ao WorkWith padrão no GeneXus 18?
[Bug] Report (Procedure) Layout: import_part leaves variable-bound controls "(none)", re-import duplicates them, PrintBlock Height is ignored; add_report_control / set_property cannot fix it
[Bug] Capacity eviction can still stop a Worker running an async build or a timed-out command
[Perf] Worker memory budgets for large KBs are still missing (second half of #344)
[Reliability] A valid shared Worker response above 16 MiB still stops the broker for every client (deferred part of #347)
[Feature/Bug] Lacunas que obrigaram trabalho manual na IDE: Query, coleção, save_as, modo texto de relatório, WWP, diagnósticos de build
[Feature] A Query object's structure cannot be read or written (parameters/query elements/output formats)
[Bug] save_as fails cloning part 'Layout' for a report Procedure (regression from the #118 hardening)
[Feature] WorkWithPlus/PatternInstance: a new control element (combo, query viewer) cannot be added via import_part
[Enhancement] A build does not warn that an internal callee's generated .cs is stale (deferred item from #409)
[Bug] User action gxobject is written as <object GUID>-<bare name>; the IDE stores <type GUID>-<qualified name>
[Bug] add_user_action only finds TableActions or a table that already holds an action, and TableActions is always ambiguous on a transaction WWP
[Bug] genexus_versioning undo reports UndoFailed for a part it restored
[Bug] Variables DSL drops decimals: NUMERIC(19,2) is written as NUMERIC(19)
[Bug] A build the Worker already finished can keep the lifecycle FIFO blocked; later builds stay queued indefinitely
[Bug] A failed native WorkWithPlus write reports only "Exception has been thrown by the target of an invocation"
[Feature] genexus_wwp: add a grid over an SDT collection to a WorkWithPlus instance (with the typed attributes it needs)
[Feature] genexus_wwp add_user_action: a button that opens an object (callObject, popup, parameters)
[Feature] genexus_dfd: entity-relationship diagram of a Transaction/Table from the SDK's own table relations
[Feature] genexus_impact: affected set with a dependencies-first rebuild order and cycle detection, instead of a heuristic risk score
[Feature] genexus_object_context: one object's identity, references and data model in a single call
[Feature] genexus_structure: read and set "Show in Default Forms" per Transaction attribute
[Feature] genexus_wwp list_tabs / tab_schema: what a WWP instance has and what the pattern allows, before add_tab
[Feature] genexus_security audit_object: fast, in-memory OWASP surface audit of a single object
